headline: Congress largely dormant as both chambers prep for Monday return with skeletal pro forma sessions.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate held a brief pro forma session on Thursday morning, meeting for just 33 seconds before adjourning. No legislative business was conducted as lawmakers took a recess break ahead of their return on August 31.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for just 3 minutes on Thursday morning, with no votes cast. Lawmakers introduced 34 new bills and 8 resolutions while committees filed 20 reports before the chamber adjourned, effectively wrapping up pre-recess activity.
